# SI032 — nondet-in-view

Views must be deterministic and cheap.

## Why

A view that fetches the web or calls an LLM cannot be used for reliable reads and breaks client polling.

## Bad

```python
@gl.public.view
def read(self) -> str:
    return gl.nondet.web.render(url)
```

## Good

```python
@gl.public.view
def read(self) -> str:
    return self.cached
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI032 -- reason
```
